title: #450 Traditional Art
prompt: Do you agree that digital art is as valuable as traditional art?

promptSegments.text: Do you agree that digital art is as valuable as traditional art?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Digital art is valuable because it provides easy and quick tools for creation.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Digital art is valuable because it provides easy and quick tools for creation.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Digital art is valuable because it allows artists to share their work with a large audience.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Digital art is valuable because it allows artists to share their work with a large audience.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The physical nature and history of traditional art give it special value.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The physical nature and history of traditional art give it special value.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The creation of traditional art requires significant time and specialized physical skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The creation of traditional art requires significant time and specialized physical skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Digital art provides artists with great freedom and efficiency through modern tools.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Digital art provides artists with great freedom and efficiency through modern tools.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Digital art has a wide reach and impact because the internet allows global sharing.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Digital art has a wide reach and impact because the internet allows global sharing.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Traditional art possesses inherent value due to its physical nature and the visible effort involved in its creation.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traditional art possesses inherent value due to its physical nature and the visible effort involved in its creation.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The physical craft and the time spent on traditional art are key components that contribute significantly to its overall worth.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The physical craft and the time spent on traditional art are key components that contribute significantly to its overall worth.
